## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated planning or recovery files.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated before claiming behavior changed.
- [ ] The producing component does not control its own evaluator.
- [ ] Canonical bytes, replay, rollback, and append-only invariants are preserved or explicitly migrated.
- [ ] No credential, private key, personal path, owner evidence, model weight, local database, or private task pack is included.
- [ ] New or changed dependencies were reviewed for advisories and licenses.
- [ ] GitHub Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs and use least-privilege permissions.
- [ ] Substantial generated-code assistance and its provenance are disclosed below.
